description: Use this to upscale a video, with one of two models. Topaz (model topazlabs-video-upscale, the default): 1080p or 4K at 30 or 60 fps, priced per second of the INPUT video: 1080p = 15 (30fps) / 30 (60fps) credits/s, 4K = 60 / 120 credits/s, so a 10s clip to 1080p30 costs 150 credits; its result is an H.265 (HEVC) 10-bit MP4, which some browsers cannot play (black frame with audio) — tell the user. FLUX 3 Video Upscale (model flux-3-video-upscale): 1.5x to 3x the input frame (input up to 2560x1440), precise (keeps faces and products) or creative (adds fine detail), keeps the frame rate and audio, H.264 output; priced per megapixel-second of OUTPUT: 95 credits precise / 135 creative, so one second of 1080p output is 188 / 267 credits and of 4K 752 / 1068 — it costs far more than Topaz, so state the price and confirm with the user first. Input up to 20 seconds (pass a URL; upload_media for local files). The price is held when the job starts and charged on success only. Jobs take a few MINUTES: the tool returns a job_id — call upscale_video again with just job_id every 30-60 seconds until it returns the finished video URL, then share it. The upscaled video is also saved to the user's BudgetPixel library.

job_id.description: A previously returned upscale job id — pass it alone to check progress and fetch the finished video URL.

mode.description: FLUX only: precise (default) keeps the source as it is (faces, products); creative adds fine detail and costs more (95 vs 135 credits per output megapixel-second).

model.description: Upscaler: topazlabs-video-upscale (default; 1080p/4K at 30/60 fps, any input size) or flux-3-video-upscale (FLUX 3 super-resolution, 1.5x-3x the input, precise or creative detail; input up to 2560x1440). target_resolution/target_fps are Topaz's; upscale_factor/mode/prompt are FLUX's.

prompt.description: FLUX only, optional: what the clip shows, to steer the detail creative mode adds (up to 1000 characters).

target_fps.description: Target frame rate (default 30). 60 fps doubles the per-second rate.

target_resolution.description: Target output resolution (default 1080p). 4K costs 4x: 1080p = 15/30 credits per input second (30/60fps), 4K = 60/120.

upscale_factor.description: FLUX only: how many times larger the output frame is (default 2). 720p at 3 is 4K.

video.description: The video to upscale: an http(s) URL (a generated video's URL, or one from upload_media for local files). Up to 20 seconds, ≤50MB. Required unless job_id is set.

name: upscale_video
title: Upscale Video
